perennials/4728868:
Four hygiene items from the July 25 report, done together because the
later work stands on them. sharp moves past the libvips CVEs (0.33 to
0.35) in both package.json files; it decodes third-party images on the
live /img path. Every server outbound fetch gains an AbortSignal
timeout, because Node's fetch has none and one hung upstream wedged a
sweep worker or an inFlight image entry forever. The spots store stops
blind-casting its JSON and validates each entry like every other store,
with the backup parser tightened to match. CI runs the rule tests before
the build, and a pull-request workflow runs typecheck plus tests, so the
class of silent regression the suite exists for is caught before deploy.

The one structural change: tokens, figs, the sun scene and the bed lines
move out of YardPage into lib/yardViews.ts as pure functions, memoized
in the page on their real inputs. YardModel's scene effect keys on figs,
so a fresh array per render meant a 4-second toast tore down and rebuilt
every mesh twice, and the hour slider re-marched every bed's day for
nothing. Fig and grownM move to the lib with them, so no lib module
runtime-imports a component. The Workbox route hosts now derive from the
same VITE_DATA_API value DATA_BASE reads, and @types/three moves to
devDependencies where a type-only package belongs.
stoop/472c222:
PLAN.md phase 6. FORMAT.md is the part meant to outlive the project: the
issue file and its seed, the piece and issue schemas, both impositions, the
address shape, and the cycle, written so somebody can implement a stoop press
without reading our source. It states the one requirement that is about
honesty rather than geometry — clipping is acceptable, clipping in silence is
not — and it ends by saying that nobody needs our permission.

The charter is demoted from the law of a federation to a constitution in the
box, a template a scene may adopt if it ever grows enough to need one.
Article III still binds, but through the license and through check.sh rather
than through a vote.

DESIGN.md keeps its objects and its loops and loses its staging: stages 2 and
3 are struck rather than deferred, on the argument that a format is harder to
capture than an institution and cheaper to keep honest.

README describes a press rather than a notebook, and says plainly what the
suites verify. CONTRIBUTING documents the new source layout, the two added
laws, the five test suites, where the QR fixtures come from, and the hoisting
rule that cost an afternoon: function declarations cross the bundle, var
assignments do not, which is why SEED_ID lives in the store.

Also drops the stale reference to src/defs.html, which has not existed for
some time.
stoop/4712e1e:
Adopt the SQLite rule: develop as parts, ship as one file. src/
holds 24 parts, none over 245 lines, split at the natural seams
(one file per view, skins/base/views css, chrome, defs, router);
build.sh assembles two shapes per page: artifact/ fragments for the
claude.ai publisher, and full documents with doctype and viewport
meta for GitHub Pages and local files, which fixes quirks-mode
rendering and broken mobile scaling on the served copies. The
migration is proven lossless: rebuilt fragments diffed byte-
identical against the previous hand-edited files before install.
check.sh makes the laws mechanical (rebuild reproducibility, the
300-line source ceiling, zero external references, page-weight
badge honesty, licenses present) and CI runs it on every push.
CONTRIBUTING.md carries the intent; tool/SPEC.md inherits the rule
for Stage 1.
